description:
## Why
fz-nhb.1 and fz-nhb.2 added 01380 and 01381 with `.oracle.exs` twins before fz-nhb.4 made `oracle: self` the form. Both programs are valid Elixir, so the twins restate the fixture.

## What changes
Each fixture is rewritten into Elixir form by the fz-nhb.4 rule and headed `# oracle: self`; its twin is deleted and its stamp regenerated.

## Signal
`ORACLE=check` passes for both; the tree holds 35 twins.
title: Fixtures 01380 and 01381 are their own Elixir oracle
